text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I just need to hand these 
documents to Gentile-san, right?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. ...Sorry, though. I just felt too 
hesitant to give it to her directly.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about it. I can see 
Gentil-san in our dorm room anytime.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
"...Buena's really amazing, isn't she? 
Rooming with a girl like that, no amount 
of courage would ever be enough."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Gentile-san is an 
exceptionally kind senior, you know!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even the other day, when I was invited to 
her family's home—

text_block_list.name: Doberman
text_block_list.text: —Bow, wow.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a doggy! What a beautiful coat, such a 
handsome boy.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Domina. ...Stay, Domina. We 
have a guest.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Playtime can wait for later. For now, 
amuse yourself with this.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? Um, what do you mean...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It's a dumbbell for dogs. A custom 10kg 
one... It's this little guy's favorite 
toy.

text_block_list.name: Doberman
text_block_list.text: (—*grab! swish swish swish...!*)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... That movement looks just like a 
dumbbell curl...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho, look at that muscle definition... 
She seems to be in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Anyone of this family's bloodline must be 
strong. ...Yes, even a dog. It must 
possess the strength to overpower any 
animal.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! Your dog is so very strong and 
sturdy, Gentile-san!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
To train until you've become this 
strong... You really are a hard worker, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Domina-chan. Is it okay if I touch her? 
Just for a little bit. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Doberman
text_block_list.text: —Woof!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at that tail wagging! Hehe, 
there, there. Good boy.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Y-You petted it!? What if a monster dog 
like that had bitten you... what would you 
have done...?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, she didn't seem like the kind of 
girl who would do something bad. ...I hope 
I can meet her again.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Classmate
text_block_list.text: ...Y-You're kidding, right...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Buena-san. Do you have a moment?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding our training match scheduled 
for today... Would you mind if we pushed 
the start time back a little?"
(Rumble, rumble, rumble...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, understood! By the way... your spirit 
is extraordinarily fierce today.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"It's like a quietly burning flame. It 
sends shivers down my spine!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My family is coming to watch my next 
race.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I must keep it sharp, noble, and honed. In 
order to show my true "strength."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
! You really are amazing...! Good luck in 
your race!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Classmate
text_block_list.text: ...N-No, no, no—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Why are you two talking so casually?! 
Can't you feel this insane "pressure"?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're so right! That's all the more 
reason why I feel I have to follow their 
example too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
To reach the scenery of my dreams... I 
need the strength to not be overwhelmed by 
this intimidation.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"So, I'm going to learn as much as I can 
from our tandem run today, Gentil-san!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha, haha... This girl is 
incredible..."

One day. While walking through the 
academy—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"You were at the race the other day too, 
weren't you? I saw you waving from the 
stands."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I just had to see Gentil-san's 
refined "strength" with my own eyes! Her 
running was truly overwhelming...!

really close.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, maybe so. After all, Gentildonna-san 
is always looking out for me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You're right, it's true that I acknowledge 
it... Buena-san's "strength," that is.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...Because as I chase my dream, 
there might be times I get to run with 
Gentile-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No matter how formidable Ms. Gentile is, 
I'll surpass her... so I can reach that 
breathtaking view!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, that's so like you. If that time 
ever comes—I shall thoroughly crush you.
